title: Image Generation
description: Fine-tuned a Stable Diffusion model on a custom dataset of 100+ images, engineering a pipeline including data augmentation and model training; achieved a 91% conformity rate for generated images.

title: Predictive Path Planning
description: Integrated a Social-GAN with an RRT* path-planning algorithm to create a predictive navigation system for a mobile robot; succeeding with a 70% success rate in avoiding collisions.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Perception
description: Built and trained a YOLOv4 model on a custom dataset of 550+ annotated images for real-time object detection; attained 90% detection accuracy.

title: Image Captioning with Attention
description: Revamped performance by 80% on SacreBLEU score by applying transfer learning on an encoder-decoder model with an attention mechanism.

title: RL for Robotic Path Planning

title: Multi-Robot Exploration & Mapping
description: Designed a multi-robot simulation for search-and-rescue, attaining 100% mapping accuracy using potential gradient obstacle avoidance.
